title: The Burnt Safehouse Again
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Yara Blackwood, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
